# H1 downstream five-target run

Date: 21 July 2026

## Completed targets

1. Stage 54 constructs the exact finite normalized retained-state kernel and
   weighted partition-ratio identity.
2. Stage 55 proves a finite entrywise Harnack criterion for uniform inverse
   vacuum weights and root moments.
3. Stage 56 proves robust Perron-envelope domination and computes the exact
   multichannel uncertainty/persistence slack.
4. Stage 57 proves changing-state-space weight cocycles and separates
   contraction per RG level from exponential decay per physical length.
5. Stage 58 composes the chain, supplies temporal/cutoff gap countermodels,
   and performs the complete C2--C6 frontier audit.

## Test totals

The stages contribute 52 passing dependency-free tests: 9, 10, 11, 11, and
11 respectively. Each stage has a two-page theorem PDF, executable results,
machine-readable dependencies, completed TODOs, a frontier ledger, and build
verification.

## Main conclusion

The run closes the finite and conditional representational mechanism, but not
its physical Yang--Mills premises. A fixed contraction per geometric RG level
is generally power-law in terminal scale, and a one-scale spatial defect
ceiling is compatible with arbitrarily small temporal gaps. The next physical
theorem must jointly establish a boundary-uniform normalized nonlinear
`SU(2)` kernel, a uniform root-weight moment, a complete multichannel ceiling,
and contraction calibrated to accumulated physical distance.
